title: Mission-light warrior call to arms
content: This post is in response to if you’ve been called to fight against the darkness in “mallworld.” This was my response to another users post. I thought it pertinent for visitors of mallworld to read. There are certain areas in “mallworld” that have portals/doorways, where the 4D darkness can get through easier, or establish nests. There has been a major uptick the last couple of months. These areas include the suburbs, the Forrest, the train station, and the docks/sewers to name a few. I’ve cleared out the forest, the suburbs, the train station and other areas before. I used to run small teams of 6-8 people or solo for these missions. About 3 months ago, I established a mission order with command, to secure the borders and clear the major nest areas. If you have been sent on more missions recently this is why. “Mallworld” is a dimensional school. Our “Hogwarts.” It is its own dimension that exists within the 5D realm of heaven and borders the 4D. There is more than one depending on location around the world. We go there to train while we sleep and re-learn what we lost while being born into this world. If you have been called to mallworld you have a purpose. Do not take your time there for granted. Observe each as much as yiu can each time you sleep and go to the mallworld. Not everyone is a soldier either.
